name: Sharing Wealth
overview: Scripture teaches that followers of Christ are called to prioritize eternal treasures over earthly wealth, as earthly riches are temporary and vulnerable to decay and theft. Jesus instructs believers to sell their possessions and give to the poor in order to store up treasure in heaven, demonstrating a heart aligned with God's kingdom. The early church exemplified this by sharing all things in common, reflecting genuine community and generosity. Additionally, the act of giving is seen in the faithful offerings brought to the treasury, showing that sharing wealth is an integral expression of worship and obedience.
